title: dbr dashboard.yml
description: Root config for an dbr project. Only `domain` and `port` are required; other keys inherit kit defaults.

domain.description: URL prefix and systemd unit name. Lowercase, alphanumeric + dash/underscore.

port.description: TCP port the Dash server binds to. Must be unique across dashboards on the same host.

title.description: User-facing title (Polish). Shown in the browser tab and chrome.

subtitle.description: Optional subtitle (Polish). Future: shown under the title.

footer.description: Footer attribution config. Future: source, updated, link.
